provenance: Sanitized latest session-authenticated LAN snapshots per run, with matching Switch applet transport user agents. Public HTTPS results are explicitly reviewed URL imports, remain marked untrusted, and are corroborated by owner replies.
openingEvidence: Opening number and handheld mode were selected by the owner. The owner confirms that Wi-Fi reconnect reopened the applet for the repeated test; applet closure is not independently observed.
conclusion: No accessible WebGL context in the tested stock applet across captive HTTP, direct LAN HTTP and reachable public HTTPS. The corresponding official source disables WebGL in its WKC feature header; final shipped build inputs are unverified.
